Name: Futan Axolotls
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
Adds small and large futan axolotl plushies to Robin's shop in pink, albino, yellow, blue, lavender and black colors ♡ Goes
perfectly with the axolotls in stardew mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16016

≽(♥ ᴗ ♥)≼

2. download this mod
3. unzip mod into stardew's mod folder

[/size][/b]♡ sprites made by me and edited from the original futan bear sprites

and alex comes from this mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11321
